recipe.name: Coconut Cartel
recipe.description: A lush and refreshing cocktail packed with bright tropical fruit flavors and rich, creamy coconut over a crisp vodka base.
steps: Add the vodka, tropical juice blend, coconut cream, and optional fresh lime juice to a cocktail shaker.
Fill the shaker with cubed ice and shake vigorously for about 15 seconds until chilled and frothy.
Strain the mixture into a tall glass filled with crushed ice.
Garnish with a tropical fruit slice and toasted coconut shavings.
recipe.garnish: Pineapple slice and toasted coconut flakes
